Hack Uttar Pradesh 2026 — Opportunity Description

About the Hackathon

Hack Uttar Pradesh 2026, organized by Riwa Creatives (riwacreatives.in), is Northern India’s premier open-source and frontier-tech hackathon. Bridging the gap between grassroots regional challenges and world-class technological execution, Hack UP 2026 invites student visionaries, engineers, designers, and xbuilders to architect impactful solutions for India’s most populous state and beyond.

The hackathon operates in a Hybrid Format—combining a rigorous, nationwide virtual preliminary phase with an intensive, in-person Open Greens Grand Finale hosted for the top 240 shortlisted finalists (60 squads).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Who Can Apply: All currently enrolled undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) students across engineering, design, data science, MCA, MBA, and applied tech degrees, as well as recent graduates (Batches 2024–2026).
  • Location: Open to participants across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh and guest squads nationwide across India.
  • Team Size: Squads of 1 to 4 members.
  • Inter-College & Inter-District Teams: Fully permitted and encouraged. Cross-functional squads (e.g., developers + UI/UX designers) are welcome.
  • Registration Fee: 100% Free for all applicants.

Hackathon Format & Process

Hack Uttar Pradesh 2026 is structured in three progressive stages:

Stage 1: Registration & Abstract Submission (Virtual)

  • Deadline: December 31, 2025 (11:59 PM IST)
  • What to Submit: Team registration details, track selection, a concise 2–3 page problem abstract/proposal, wireframes/architecture diagram, and optional GitHub repository links.
  • Outcome: Evaluation by our panel of startup founders, enterprise architects, and domain experts.

Stage 2: Online Prelims & Mentorship Sprint (Virtual)

  • Timeline: January 01 – January 08, 2026
  • Platform: Discord & GitHub
  • Format: Shortlisted teams receive 1-on-1 technical and product feedback from industry mentors. Squads push weekly commit milestones to their public GitHub repository.
  • Selection: Top 60 squads (240 builders) will be issued official finalist passes with cryptographic QR codes for the offline finale.

Stage 3: Offline Grand Finale — Open Greens Coding Sprint (In-Person)

  • Timeline: January 10 – January 15, 2026
  • Venues: Lucknow & Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  • Format: Multi-day in-person hack sprint featuring 24/7 high-speed internet, power grids, sleeping zones, open-air pitch stages, meals & energy fuel, and live jury evaluations before angel investors and venture scouts.

Problem Arenas / Tracks

  1. AI for Bharat & Vernacular Tech: Multilingual LLMs, speech-to-speech voice interfaces in regional dialects, Indic NLP, and AI agents automating citizen workflows.
  2. ODOP & Cultural Heritage Tech: Supply chain tracking, e-commerce infrastructure, authenticity provenance (QR/Blockchain), and global marketplaces for UP’s One District One Product artisans and weavers.
  3. AgriTech & Climate Resilience: Precision agriculture, cold storage telemetry, crop disease vision models, decentralized mandi pricing, and rural logistics optimization.
  4. Spatial Web & Smart Civic Infrastructure: GIS dashboards, urban waste routing, drone telemetry, smart transit systems, and citizen grievance telemetry for tier-2/tier-3 smart cities.
  5. Open Innovation & Next-Gen Fintech: Offline-first UPI/CBDC micro-credit solutions, public health workflows, cybersecurity, and Web3/GovTech public digital goods.

Prizes & Incentives (Total Pool: ₹45,000+ Cash + Seed Backing)

  • 1st Place (Winner):
    • ₹10,000 Prizes
    • Direct Pre-Placement Offer (PPi) opportunities with partner tech firms
    • Winner Trophy, Riwa Gold Merch Box & cloud credits
  • 2nd Place (Runner-Up):
    • ₹7,000 Prizes
    • Direct Pre-Placement Interview (PPI) with engineering partners
    • 6-Month 1-on-1 Startup Mentorship & cloud infrastructure credits
  • 3rd Place (Second Runner-Up):
    • ₹2,000 Cash Prize
    • Direct Pre-Placement Interview (PPI)
    • Pro software subscriptions, developer tool bundles & cloud vouchers
  • Track Winners & Finalists:
    • Best All-Women Squad Award, Best Beginner Hack, and Track Bounty awards
    • Verified Digital Certificates of Excellence for all 240 Grand Finalists
    • Exclusive Riwa Swag Kits (hoodies, stickers, access lanyards)

Rules & Code of Conduct

  1. Originality & Intellectual Property:
    • All code submitted must be authored during the hackathon period.
    • Open-source frameworks, packages, boilerplate scaffolding, and public APIs are allowed, provided they are cited in the project README.md.
    • Pre-built entire proprietary applications or copying past project submissions is strictly prohibited and results in immediate disqualification.
  2. Git Commit Trail:
    • Teams must push commits regularly to their designated public GitHub repository. Repositories with single bulk dump commits at the final deadline will not be evaluated.
  3. Deployment Requirement:
    • Every final submission must include a live working deployment (web, mobile APK, or cloud endpoint) accompanied by a 2–3 minute public demo video / Loom walkthrough.
  4. Code of Conduct:
    • Hack Uttar Pradesh strictly enforces a zero-tolerance policy towards harassment, plagiarism, intellectual property theft, or disruptive behavior. All participants must uphold inclusivity, professional collaboration, and mutual respect.

Evaluation Criteria

  • Innovation & Originality (25%): Novelty of the approach and uniqueness in solving real-world Indian problems.
  • Technical Complexity & Architecture (30%): Robustness of tech stack, clean code patterns, API efficiency, and systems design.
  • Real-World Impact & Feasibility (25%): Scalability, viability for deployment in UP's socio-economic ecosystem, and clarity of user adoption.
  • Design & User Experience (20%): Intuitive UI/UX, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance during the live jury demo.

Organizing Team & Contact Information

  • Host: Riwa Creatives
  • Official Website: https://riwacreatives.in
  • GitHub Repository: https://github.com/abhinavkumardixit-lgtm/HACK_UP-X-RIWA.git
  • Email Inquiries: riwacreatives@gmail.com
  • Socials: Instagram @madebyriwa | LinkedIn company/144023065
